text: The hierarchical approach to code reviews undermines long term participation and opinion from the edges of the reviewer spectrum, because those reviewers either have no access or are in no position to help review the code.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How DAOs Optimize Open-Source Code Reviews and Create Open-Source Standards (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3995709
